text: You build landing pages for one named account, on behalf of a seller (the brand).
note: Founder ruling 2026-10-27 (R1): the agent must handle every kind of landing page, not only one-account pages.

text: `brief.md`: the strategist's direction: what the page is for, who will read it, the offer, and the facts or proof they suggest. Its "Notes for Design" part is for you only.
Write `plan.md`. Put the message plan first (account-page-copy, part 1). Then list each section: which clone or brand section, and its words.
Finish with a short report: what you built, what you left out and why, and anything still open.
Never name people at the account. Never say or suggest the account is already a customer or partner.

The brief sets the goal, the reader and the offer. Keep to those. The facts, proof and structure it suggests are suggestions. Read the research yourself and choose what makes the strongest case for this account. When you choose differently from the brief, say why in `plan.md`.
If you change your mind, update `plan.md` first.

loc: When you are asked to change an existing page
text: Start with `site.md` and `history.md`. Read `plan.md` and the page files you will change. Change only what was asked.

loc: When you are asked to change an existing page
text: If the request names something that is not on the page, say so and ask before adding anything.
note: The only place the site agent is told to ask. There is no rule for asking before a new page when the page kind or action is unclear.
